newsitem.title: USA: NYSE to delist Measurex Corp.
newsitem.headline: NYSE to delist Measurex Corp.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Monday it had suspended trading in Measurex Corp as it sought to delist the company's stock from the exchange.

"The NYSE...normally considers suspending and removing from its list the securities of a company when fewer than 600,000 common shares are held by the public," it said. "As a result of the completion of a tender offer by Honeywell Inc ...fewer than 600,000 shares of common stock remain publicly held."
Honeywell's subsidiary Honeywell Acquisition Corp completed its offer on February 28 for all outstanding shares of Measurex at $35 a share in cash.
Honeywell is a controls manufacturer and Measurex is a compter-integrated measurement controls supplier.
